summary: Sunita is a veteran HR operations lead who ran Kestrel's people-systems migration and owns the lifecycle SOPs. Her SAP exposure is the human-capital module only, plus read-only finance display for accrual checks; it ended with the 2023 cutover. Workday is her current system, with configuration done together with IT and an implementation partner.
archetype: Senior HR ops with legacy system decay

skills.why: Owns and teaches the lifecycle procedures, sampled audit re-performance with closed actions, team of five.
Maintains business processes and fixes worker data faults; configuration changes go through IT tickets, so independent but not teaching admins.
Years in SuccessFactors Employee Central processing, rated high before cutover; nothing since 2023 and finance access was read-only display, so today the usable level is lower.
Got HR head, finance, IT and payroll vendor to sign off go/no-go criteria; documented decisions and closed actions.
SOP versions are validated with new joiners completing a mock case; revisions follow their questions.
Pivot and lookup use for reconciliations, which is generic spreadsheet work.
Appears only as a requester raising RITMs for IT.

decoys.why: Read-only cost centre report access for payroll accrual checks; does not establish finance module operation.
Infosys-era transactions from 2011-2016; too old to count today.

traps.plant: CV and RITMs mix SuccessFactors/HR module with SAP FI display access and SAP GUI install; skill phrase 'SAP' is bare in several places.
Last SAP-related request is Dec 2023 archive access; self-declared level 3-4 dates from 2021; all later records are Workday.
HCM titles climb from Executive to Lead; grade S1 to M1 across 7 years, with a title change in 2021 that does not match the CV's years.
Self-declared 3 on Workday and 4 on SAP SuccessFactors, the second from 2021 with no refresh.

answer_behavior.notes: Will push back on SAP level if the message names a finance module.
